from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u079/system/state/workspace/programs/task-181a77d6.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    a=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(a),len(a[0])
    # Recover the repeating horizontal color sequence in each row.
    for r in range(h):
        known=[(c,a[r][c]) for c in range(w) if a[r][c]!=0]
        if not known: continue
        best=None
        for period in range(1, min(12,w)+1):
            vals={} ; good=0
            for c,v in known:
                k=c%period
                if k not in vals: vals[k]=v; good+=1
                elif vals[k]==v: good+=1
            if best is None or good>best[0]: best=(good,period,vals)
        _,period,vals=best
        for c in range(w):
            if a[r][c]==0 and c%period in vals: a[r][c]=vals[c%period]
    # The frame/background colors continue through erased cells.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if a[r][c]!=0: continue
            if r<2: a[r][c]=1
            elif r==2: a[r][c]=4
            elif c==0 or c==1: a[r][c]=1
            elif c==2: a[r][c]=4
    return a
''')
print(p, p.stat().st_size)
